node: Healthcare licensure program capacity: nursing, OTA, counseling, social work, and related programs
summary: Layer 1B expanded the universe around the clinical-capacity chokepoint rather than generic online education. Reference names are Grand Canyon Education and Adtalem because both have direct exposure to licensure-linked healthcare education capacity. The underfollowed lane highlights HealthStream as a healthcare workforce, credentialing, clinical-rotation, and training software supplier that may benefit from the same capacity constraints without screening as an education company. zSpace is included only as a speculative shadow candidate because its AR/VR healthcare training exposure is directly relevant but the company appears micro-cap and financially fragile.
